test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The total surface area of a sphere is 6006 cm² less than the total surface area of a hemisphere. If the ratio between the radii of the hemisphere and sphere is 5 : 3, then find the radius of the sphere.

 (Use pi = (22)/(7))
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of radii (Hemisphere : Sphere) = 5 : 3

Total Surface Area (TSA) units ratio = (3 × 5²) : (4 × 3²) = 75 : 36

Difference in TSA units = 75 − 36 = 39 units

39 × (π × x²) = 6006 ⇒ 39 × (22/7) × x² = 6006

x² = (6006 × 7) / (39 × 22) = 49 ⇒ x = 7

Radius of sphere = 3 × 7 = 21 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 21 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Difference in TSA = 6006 cm²

Ratio of radii (rₕ : rₛ) = 5 : 3

π = 22/7

**Formula Used:**

Total surface area of sphere = 4πr²

Total surface area of hemisphere = 3πr²

 
• rₛ = 3x Sphere 
 
• rₕ = 5x Hemisphere TSA Difference = 6006 cm²

**Calculations:**

Let the radius of the hemisphere be rₕ = 5x and the radius of the sphere be rₛ = 3x.

⇒ TSA of hemisphere − TSA of sphere = 6006

⇒ 3πrₕ² − 4πrₛ² = 6006

⇒ π [3 × (5x)² − 4 × (3x)²] = 6006

⇒ (22/7) [3 × 25x² − 4 × 9x²] = 6006

⇒ (22/7) [75x² − 36x²] = 6006

⇒ (22/7) × 39x² = 6006

⇒ 39x² = (6006 × 7) / 22

⇒ 39x² = 273 × 7

⇒ x² = (273 × 7) / 39

⇒ x² = 7 × 7 = 49

⇒ x = √49 = 7

⇒ Radius of sphere (rₛ) = 3x = 3 × 7 = 21 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 21 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of Sphere

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = Total Surface Area (TSA) = 4πr². Volume = (4/3)πr³.

Properties of Hemisphere

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 2πr². Total Surface Area (TSA) = 3πr². Volume = (2/3)πr³.

Ratio of TSA and Radius

If the radius is multiplied by a factor k, the surface area is multiplied by k² and the volume by k³.
